meta.routes_note: Routes are approximate scholarly reconstructions drawn as corridors through hand-placed waypoints. weight is a qualitative tier (major 1.0, secondary 0.6, minor 0.3), not a measured volume.
meta.cities_note: Populations are historians' estimates (Chandler 1987; Modelski 2003) as geocoded by Reba, Reitsma & Seto 2016 (Sci Data 3:160034, CC BY 4.0). confidence is the dataset's location-certainty rank. size = sqrt(pop/max pop in this era).
